name: We'll Be Alright
source:
Jonghyun, a strange cafe owner, runs the Zodiac Cafe with a side business in the back. He tells fortunes from reading tea leaves for curious customers- who lean more supernatural than not. Even mythological entities want to know how their life will pan out!

[from [url=https://rhyses-pieces.itch.io/well-be-alright]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
古怪的咖啡馆老板钟铉经营着黄道咖啡馆，还在后面做着一门副业。他为好奇的顾客通过茶叶渣占卜，而这些顾客，多半不是普通人。就连神话中的存在，也想知道自己的生活将走向何方！

[摘自[url=https://rhyses-pieces.itch.io/well-be-alright]itch.io[/url]]
